adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a persistent `posts.cook_method` and changes `Post#cook` to return `raw` verbatim when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb). `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html` and `skip_validations: true` using HTML from RSS (`i.content`) or `ruby-readability` (`doc.content`) without sanitization, and the embed view renders `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). Since `cook_method` persists and `PostRevisor` does not reset it on edit, any later revision of such a post will continue to bypass the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline, allowing arbitrary HTML to be stored into `cooked` and rendered, enabling XSS by whoever can edit that post (including the non-admin `embed_by_username` author).
